description: Published Triplet-SVM pre-miRNA classifier (Xue et al. 2005) with the authors' trained libsvm model.

sequence.description: Query nucleotide sequence (RNA or DNA; T read as U)

dotBracket.description: Optional structure in '.()' notation (same length); folded when omitted

minBasePairs.description: Minimum paired bases per arm of a retrieved stem-loop (≥ 1)

minLoopSize.description: Minimum hairpin loop size of the fold (≥ 0; only when folding)

found.description: True iff at least one stem-loop was scored

candidates.description: One entry per scored stem-loop (start, end, sequence, dotBracket, features, decisionValue, isPreMiRna)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
dotBracket must have the same length as the sequence.
